name: forge-bridge
description: Local companion process: discovers this machine's Claude Code sessions via the Agent SDK, relays live hook events, and lets Forge's browser UI read history and resume a session directly from localhost. Never runs on Vercel/Cloudflare -- this is the one piece of Forge's Claude Code integration that has to live on the user's own machine, because the Agent SDK's resume/discovery APIs only work against the local filesystem.
